notes.title: Patch 4 Notes
notes.notes:
Patch 4 Notes

Fixes:

 Fixed key mapping not saving correctly.
 Fixed volume settings not saving correctly.
 Reduced block reset timer.

notes.title: Hotfix 1 Notes
notes.notes:
Hotfix 1 Notes

Fixes:

 Fixed vulnerability bugs introduced for Chase and Rollo by Patch 3.

notes.title: Patch 3 Notes
notes.notes:
Patch 3 Notes

Fixes:

 Fixed instances where player punches look like they should have connected, but do not do damage or stagger the opponent
 Tweaked some reaction behavior of Zeke
 Fixed timer in the vtuber mini-game not displaying correctly
 Added background music to the Arcade Mode menu

notes.title: Release Day Patch 2 Notes
notes.notes:
Release Day Patch 2 Notes

Fixes:

 Fixed a loop where the game would load back to the main menu when pressing play after completing the main game. The game will now load the player to before starting the end sequence.

notes.title: Release Day Patch 1 Notes
notes.notes:
Release Day Patch 1 Notes

Fixes:

 Updated Arcade mode (unlocked after completing the main game) to allow for replaying individual fights.
 Tweaks to Arcade mode menu
 Fixed some text clipping for instruction screens and fighter card screens
